'''Zapup''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Zapooch]] at 1 star.

==Overview==
Current Description: "As the very first Tatari, a slight tendency to short circuit here and there is perfectly understandable."

Zapup is your starting Tatari when you first begin playing the game, given to you at the start of the tutorial, along with [[Clucky]].

He is your trusty companion, and is featured heavily throughout the game in the background, in-game assets, and promotional artwork/images.

==Skill Properties==

* '''Damage Factor''' - 55%
* '''Damage Count''' - 6
* '''Cooldown''' - 4.5s
* '''Arena Factor''' - 25%

==Appearance==
Zapup is a small, yellow round canine creature. It has thick, curled eyelids which make it appear to be angry. It has a short, round white muzzle between its two small brown beady oval eyes. It has two brown ears standing up and has 4 of short, brown limbs. Its belly is covered in a white round segment, and its yellow tail with brown tip is fluffy.

==Strategy==
[[File:Zapup Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Zapup's attack range]]
As said above, and unlike other Tatari, it can't stay in this evolution stage after the tutorial. See [[Zapooch]] for more information.
{{clear|left}}

==Trivia==

* Zapup previously was the only Tatari in the game who was guaranteed to evolve at 1 star, after you finished the game's tutorial.
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "If Zapup was dyed red, you'd think its a [[Sparkit]]. It's time to evolve so you can tell it apart."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26, its bio description said: "Zapup's entire body is covered in fluffy, electrically charged fur that can function as a backup power bank, charging up any gadgets nearby."
* Zapup is said to be the first Tatari created by [[NPCs#Doctor Looney|Doctor Looney]]. Before it was Zapup, it was a regular puppy that was given to [[NPCs#The Player|the player]] on his birthday.<ref>https://www.instagram.com/p/DYUvvVeGv9S/?img_index=1</ref>

===Name origin===
Zapup is a combination of ''zap'', a charge of electricity, and ''pup'', the name given to a young dog.
